name: Skyline Stack
description: Race to build your tallest tower in 45 seconds. Tap to land the sliding block; overhang is trimmed away. Three perfect drops in a row grow your platform back. Missed? Build again: your best height stays on the board.
howToPlay: Tap DROP BLOCK when the moving block lines up with your tower.
Overhang is cut away. Three perfect drops in a row grow the platform back.
Build again after a miss. Your tallest tower in 45 seconds wins; equal heights tie.
